report.rootCause: JPQL query tries to JOIN FETCH a non-existent persistent attribute 'lines' on PurchaseInvoice entity - lines is a derived Java method, not a JPA @OneToMany relationship
report.currentBehavior: Query 'SELECT DISTINCT i FROM PurchaseInvoice i JOIN FETCH i.lines WHERE i.restaurant.id = :restaurantId AND i.invoiceDate BETWEEN :from AND :to' fails because 'lines' is not a mapped JPA relationship
report.expectedBehavior: Query should either use a proper @OneToMany relationship or remove JOIN FETCH and rely on the getLines() method in Java code
evidence: PurchaseInvoice.java lines 55-63: getLines() is a derived method accessing goodsReceipt.getLines(), not a persistent @OneToMany mappedBy field
PurchaseInvoiceRepository.java line 21: Query uses 'JOIN FETCH i.lines' which requires a JPA @OneToMany relationship that doesn't exist
report.recommendedFix: Remove 'JOIN FETCH i.lines' from the JPQL query on line 21. Change to: 'SELECT DISTINCT i FROM PurchaseInvoice i WHERE i.restaurant.id = :restaurantId AND i.invoiceDate BETWEEN :from AND :to'. The service layer already calls getLines() method to access invoice lines via the GoodsReceipt.
